text: t[2] God of my ancestors, Lord of mercy, [AA]you who have made all things by your word [AB]
And in your wisdom have established humankindto rule the creatures produced by you, [AC]
And to govern the world in holiness and righteousness,and to render judgment in integrity of heart: [AD]
Give me Wisdom, the consort at your throne,and do not reject me from among your children; [AE]
For I am your servant, the child of your maidservant,a man weak and short-livedand lacking in comprehension of judgment and of laws. [AF]
Indeed, though one be perfect among mortals,if Wisdom, who comes from you, be lacking,that one will count for nothing. [AG]
You have chosen me king over your peopleand magistrate over your sons and daughters. [AH]
You have bid me build a temple on your holy mountainand an altar in the city that is your dwelling place,a copy of the holy tabernacle which you had established from of old. [AI]
Now with you is Wisdom, who knows your worksand was present when you made the world;Who understands what is pleasing in your eyesand what is conformable with your commands. [AJ]
Send her forth from your holy heavensand from your glorious throne dispatch herThat she may be with me and work with me,that I may know what is pleasing to you. [AK]
For she knows and understands all things,and will guide me prudently in my affairsand safeguard me by her glory; [AL]
Thus my deeds will be acceptable,and I will judge your people justlyand be worthy of my father's throne. [AM]
For who knows God's counsel,or who can conceive what the Lord intends? [AN]
For the deliberations of mortals are timid,and uncertain our plans.
t[3] For the corruptible body burdens the souland the earthly tent weighs down the mind with its many concerns. [AO]
Scarcely can we guess the things on earth,and only with difficulty grasp what is at hand;but things in heaven, who can search them out? [AP]
Or who can know your counsel, unless you give Wisdomand send your holy spirit from on high? [AQ]
t[4] Thus were the paths of those on earth made straight,and people learned what pleases you,and were saved by Wisdom. [AR]
